name: no-embedded-template-assets
body: The kalide binary must contain no templates, themes, fonts, logos or other presentation media (images, video, …). Every template, theme and media file used to validate, render, list or serve a deck must be read at run time from the resolved library root — the configured `templates:` path in `kalide.yaml` when set, otherwise the local `templates/` directory (see external-template-library) — never from the binary. There is no built-in fallback: if the resolved library lacks something, it is an error. The core of the tool — the vendored reveal.js runtime and the deck/error/gallery page shells — is not a template asset and is embedded. The only other embedded content is the minimal scaffold written verbatim by the scaffolding commands and never read by validate/render/serve/list code paths: the `kalide init` seed tree (written to disk once by no-arg init) and the static, text-only `AGENTS.md` scaffold guide files (requirements.requirement.agent-authoring) — the shared deck-author guide written by `kalide init` and `kalide init <path>`, and the library/template-author guide written by `kalide init-library`. These guide files are scaffold content, not template assets, and must never be referenced as one. None of the embedded content carries a brand (global.constraint.core-unbranded).
